title: ManualModelConversion / Supported models for conversion
content:
## Supported models for conversion

The following table lists models supported for conversion to ONNX format in the Foundry Toolkit:

| Support Matrix | Supported now | Under development | On the roadmap |
| :------------: | :-----------: | :---------------: | :------------: |
| Model architectures | `DeepSeek`, `Gemma`, `Llama`, `Mistral`, `Phi (Language + Vision)`, `Qwen`, `Nemotron`, `Granite`, `AMD OLMo` | `Whisper` | `Stable Diffusion` |
